paper.title_en: Kinematic Bounds on Charged Energy Extraction in the Purely Electric Branch of Euler--Heisenberg Type f(R,T) Black Holes
paper.abstract_en: We derive and test kinematic upper bounds on charged energy extraction in the purely electric branch of a static $f(R,T)$ black hole family sourced by an Euler--Heisenberg type nonlinear electromagnetic sector. The analysis is restricted to external, minimally coupled probe particles on the fixed background. In this electric solution the field remains Coulombic up to an additive gauge constant; the nonlinear electromagnetic and matter-coupling coefficients therefore affect extraction indirectly through the metric, the event-horizon position, and the global causal structure. We obtain a general local bound retaining nonzero angular momentum and radial velocity of the negative energy fragment, and identify the commonly used zero angular momentum turning-point choice as an upper envelope rather than a generic decay configuration. A co-moving split supplies a locally four momentum-conserving benchmark. We classify horizons with the double root conditions $\mathcal F=\mathcal F'=0$, distinguish asymptotically flat, de Sitter, and anti-de Sitter branches, and impose the corresponding global outward-accessibility criterion. In the de Sitter static patch the electrostatic energy is referenced to the cosmological horizon, so the relevant scale is $Q(1/r_+-1/r_c)$ rather than $Q/r_+$. Reproducible scans compare Reissner--Nordström, Einstein--Euler--Heisenberg type, $f(R,T)$--Maxwell, and full $f(R,T)$--Euler--Heisenberg type backgrounds. The results show that the branch-referenced horizon potential controls the local upper envelope, whereas the asymptotic structure determines whether an outward trajectory can reach infinity, a cosmological horizon, or only a finite outer turning point.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文深入研究了f(R,T)黑洞中带电能量提取的运动学上限，涉及非线性电动力学和因果结构，理论深度高，方法扎实，具有新颖性。
decision.title_zh: Euler–Heisenberg型f(R,T)黑洞纯电分支中带电能量提取的运动学界限
decision.abstract_zh: 我们在静态f(R,T)黑洞家族的纯电分支中推导并检验了带电能量提取的运动学上限，该家族由Euler–Heisenberg型非线性电磁扇区提供。分析仅限于固定背景上的外部最小耦合探针粒子。在这个电学解中，场保持库仑形式，直到附加规范常数；因此，非线性电磁和物质耦合系数通过度规、事件视界位置以及全局因果结构间接影响提取。我们获得了保留负能量碎片非零角动量和径向速度的一般局部界限，并确定了常用的零角动量转折点选择是上包络而非一般衰减构型。一个共动分解提供了局部四动量守恒基准。我们用双根条件F=F'=0对视界进行分类，区分渐近平坦、de Sitter和anti-de Sitter分支，并施加相应的全局外向可达性准则。在de Sitter静态补丁中，静电能量参考宇宙视界，因此相关尺度是Q(1/r_+-1/r_c)而非Q/r_+。可重复的扫描比较了Reissner–Nordström、Einstein–Euler–Heisenberg型、f(R,T)–Maxwell和完整的f(R,T)–Euler–Heisenberg型背景。结果表明，分支参考的视界势控制局部上包络，而渐近结构决定外向轨迹是否能到达无穷远、宇宙视界或仅到达有限的外转折点。
